812d8e59f3.q: What is Constitutional AI and how does Anthropic use it to train Claude?
812d8e59f3.a: Constitutional AI is a training framework that gives Claude an ethical system and moral framework rather than just rewarding correct answers. Anthropic trained it using various documents including the U.N. Declaration of Human Rights and Apple terms of service, allowing the model to understand how people should be treated and grapple with complex ethical questions. This approach has both increased the ethicalness of answers and improved overall model intelligence and capability.

5c15f8bdc1.q: What safety improvement has Waymo achieved compared to human drivers in crash reduction?
5c15f8bdc1.a: When Waymo was at 127 million fully autonomous miles, they established a 10x reduction in injury-causing or worse crashes than human driving in those same areas. Around pedestrians, they are 12 times safer than humans. A study with Swiss Free, an insurance company, found that the Waymo driver was 12 times safer than a human in most instances.
